{{Short description|American statistician, professor, and author}}
{{BLP primary sources|date=September 2023}}
[[File:David-Stoffer.jpg|alt=Picture of David Stoffer|thumb|174x174px]]
'''David S. Stoffer''' is an American [[statistician]], and [[Professor Emeritus]] of Statistics at the [[University of Pittsburgh]].<ref>{{Cite web |title=🐩 Stoffer's GitHome |url=https://dsstoffer.github.io/ |access-date=2023-09-06 |website=Stoffer’s GitHome |language=en-US}}</ref>  He is the author of several books on [[time series analysis]], ''Time Series Analysis and Its Applications: With R Examples''<ref>{{Cite journal|author1-link=Robert H. Shumway |last1=Shumway |first1=Robert H. |last2=Stoffer |first2=David S. |date=2017 |title=Time Series Analysis and Its Applications |url=https://link.springer.com/book/10.1007/978-3-319-52452-8 |journal=Springer Texts in Statistics |language=en |doi=10.1007/978-3-319-52452-8 |isbn=978-3-319-52451-1 |issn=1431-875X|url-access=subscription }}</ref>  with [[Robert H. Shumway]], ''Nonlinear Time Series: Theory, Methods, and Applications with R Examples''<ref>{{Cite book |last1=Douc |first1=Randal |title=Nonlinear Time Series: Theory, Methods, and Applications With R examples |last2=Moulines |first2=Eric |last3=Stoffer |first3=David S. |date=2014 |publisher=CRC Press |isbn=978-1-4665-0225-3 |series=Texts in statistical science |location=Boca Raton, Fla.}}</ref> with R. Douc and E. Moulines, and ''Time Series: A Data Analysis Approach Using R''<ref>{{Cite web |title=Time Series: A Data Analysis Approach Using R |url=https://www.routledge.com/Time-Series-A-Data-Analysis-Approach-Using-R/Shumway-Stoffer/p/book/9780367221096 |access-date=2023-09-06 |website=Routledge & CRC Press |language=en}}</ref> with Robert H. Shumway.

Stoffer's research includes papers on the subject of time series analysis, for example,  with missing data in ''An Approach to Time Series Smoothing and Forecasting Using the EM Algorithm''<ref>{{Cite journal |last1=Shumway |first1=R. H. |last2=Stoffer |first2=D. S. |title=An Approach to Time Series Smoothing and Forecasting Using the Em Algorithm |date=1982 |url=https://onlinelibrary.wiley.com/doi/10.1111/j.1467-9892.1982.tb00349.x |journal=Journal of Time Series Analysis |language=en |volume=3 |issue=4 |pages=253–264 |doi=10.1111/j.1467-9892.1982.tb00349.x |issn=0143-9782|url-access=subscription }}</ref> published in the ''[[Journal of Time Series Analysis]]'', the spectral analysis of qualitative time series in ''Spectral Analysis For Categorical Time Series: Scaling and the Spectral Envelope''<ref>{{Cite journal |last1=Stoffer |first1=David S. |last2=Tyler |first2=David E. |last3=McDougall |first3=Andrew J. |date=1993 |title=Spectral Analysis for Categorical Time Series: Scaling and the Spectral Envelope |url=https://www.jstor.org/stable/2337182 |journal=Biometrika |volume=80 |issue=3 |pages=611–622 |doi=10.2307/2337182 |jstor=2337182 |issn=0006-3444|url-access=subscription }}</ref> published in ''[[Biometrika]],'' and numerical methods for time series in ''A Monte Carlo Approach to Nonnormal and Nonlinear State-Space Modeling''<ref>{{Cite journal |last1=Carlin |first1=Bradley P. |last2=Polson |first2=Nicholas G. |last3=Stoffer |first3=David S. |date=1992 |title=A Monte Carlo Approach to Nonnormal and Nonlinear State-Space Modeling |url=http://www.tandfonline.com/doi/abs/10.1080/01621459.1992.10475231 |journal=Journal of the American Statistical Association |language=en |volume=87 |issue=418 |pages=493–500 |doi=10.1080/01621459.1992.10475231 |issn=0162-1459|url-access=subscription }}</ref>  and ''Bootstrapping State-Space Models: Gaussian Maximum Likelihood Estimation and the Kalman Filter''<ref>{{Cite journal |last1=Stoffer |first1=David S. |last2=Wall |first2=Kent D. |date=1991 |title=Bootstrapping State-Space Models: Gaussian Maximum Likelihood Estimation and the Kalman Filter |url=http://www.tandfonline.com/doi/abs/10.1080/01621459.1991.10475148 |journal=Journal of the American Statistical Association |language=en |volume=86 |issue=416 |pages=1024–1033 |doi=10.1080/01621459.1991.10475148 |issn=0162-1459|url-access=subscription }}</ref> both published in the ''[[Journal of the American Statistical Association]].'' Many of his contributions are explained with numerical examples in his [[Springer Nature|Springer]] text, ''Time Series Analysis and Its Applications: With R Examples'' ({{ISBN|978-3-319-52451-1}}).

In 1989 Stoffer, along with collaborators from the [[University of Pittsburgh School of Medicine]], received the ''[[American Statistical Association]]'s Outstanding Statistical Application Award''<ref>{{Cite web |date=2016-04-08 |title=Outstanding Statistical Application Award |url=https://www.amstat.org/awards/outstandingstatisticalapplicationaward.cfm |access-date=2023-09-06 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160408225512/https://www.amstat.org/awards/outstandingstatisticalapplicationaward.cfm |archive-date=2016-04-08 }}</ref>  for the article ''A Walsh-Fourier Analysis of the Effects of Moderate Maternal Alcohol Consumption on Neonatal Sleep-State Cycling''<ref>{{Cite journal |last1=Stoffer |first1=David S. |last2=Scher |first2=Mark S. |last3=Richardson |first3=Gale A. |last4=Day |first4=Nancy L. |last5=Coble |first5=Patricia A. |date=1988 |title=A Walsh-Fourier Analysis of the Effects of Moderate Maternal Alcohol Consumption on Neonatal Sleep-State Cycling |url=https://www.jstor.org/stable/2290119 |journal=Journal of the American Statistical Association |volume=83 |issue=404 |pages=954–963 |doi=10.2307/2290119 |jstor=2290119 |issn=0162-1459|url-access=subscription }}</ref> published in the ''[[Journal of the American Statistical Association]].''  The award was presented to Stoffer in person at the [[Joint Statistical Meetings]] (JSM) held in [[Washington, D.C.]].{{citation needed|date=September 2023}}

Stoffer's research was continually supported by the [[National Science Foundation|U.S. National Science Foundation (NSF)]]<ref>{{Cite web |title=NSF Award Search: Simple Search Results. |url=https://www.nsf.gov/awardsearch/simpleSearchResult?queryText=stoffer |access-date=2023-09-06 |website=www.nsf.gov}}</ref> and in 2008, he became a Program Director for two years at the NSF Division of Mathematical Sciences (DMS) through the [[Intergovernmental Personnel Act]] (IPA) program.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Intergovernmental Personnel Act (IPA) Assignments |url=https://new.nsf.gov/careers/rotator-programs/intergovernmental-personnel-act-ipa-assignments |access-date=2023-09-06 |website=NSF - National Science Foundation |language=en}}</ref> He returned to NSF-DMS in the first part of 2018 as a Program Director.{{citation needed|date=September 2023}}

In 2006, Stoffer was named [[List of fellows of the American Statistical Association|Fellow of the American Statistical Association]],<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://ww2.amstat.org/fellows/|title= ASA Fellows |website=American Statistical Association}}</ref> and in 2020 he was named a ''Wiley, [[Journal of Time Series Analysis]] Distinguished Author''.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Wiley, Journal of Time Series Analysis, Distinguished Author Award |doi=10.1111/(ISSN)1467-9892 |url=https://onlinelibrary.wiley.com/page/journal/14679892/homepage/distinguished-authors }}</ref>

Stoffer has acted as Editor or Associate Editor for the ''[[Journal of Time Series Analysis]], [[Journal of Forecasting]], [[Annals of the Institute of Statistical Mathematics]], [[Journal of Business & Economic Statistics|Journal of Business and Economic Statistics]],'' and ''[[Journal of the American Statistical Association]]''.{{citation needed|date=September 2023}}
